title: Dark Depths golden test shows Opponent at 20 life instead of 0
description:
The dark_depths_combo golden test shows Marit Lage attacking for lethal, but the Opponent's life total still shows 20 because the spectator's last snapshot is captured at DECLARE_BLOCKERS (before combat damage resolves). When combat damage kills the Opponent, the game ends instantly — the spectator never captures a snapshot with Opponent at 0 life.

The fix would be to have the streaming spectator emit a final snapshot when the game ends (from the game_over event), reflecting the actual final life totals. This would also improve the game replay viewer for any game that ends via lethal combat damage.
